principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix automotive grit with Swiss precision.
Content is King: Data density must be legible but beautiful.
Zoom In: High-fidelity details on parts and status.
Negative Space: Use it to group functional areas, not just for aesthetics.
Contrast: High contrast for workshop visibility (dark mode is critical).
anti_patterns: Low contrast text (must be readable in a greasy workshop).

heading.usage: Page titles, KPI values, KDS ticket headers

body.usage: General UI text, descriptions, form labels

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs.
Data values (prices, stock) must use tabular-nums.

dashboard.name: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density)
dashboard.rules: Every pixel utilized. No jagged bottoms. Use h-full.

kds.name: Kitchen Display Grid
kds.rules: Strict columns. Cards expand vertically. High contrast headers.

containers.card: rounded-none border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm
containers.kds_ticket: rounded-md border-2 border-transparent bg-card shadow-md overflow-hidden

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dashboard backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.

images.strategy: Use high-quality Unsplash images. If tool fails, use these reliable IDs.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@fontsource/barlow-condensed', '@fontsource/public-sans', and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono' to package.json.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to use these font families and the custom color palette.
3. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build a 'DashboardLayout' with a sidebar and a 'KDSLayout' (full screen, no sidebar).
4. BUILD COMPONENTS: Create 'KDSTicket', 'InventoryCard', 'MetricWidget' components using the design rules.
5. THEME TOGGLE: Implement a theme toggle that respects system preference but allows manual override.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
7. NO GRADIENTS: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
8. KDS SCREEN: This is a critical feature. It must look like a McDonald's screen - high contrast, big text, clear status indicators.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Dark mode is not just inverted light mode; it needs specific color tuning.
